camel_example: aliyun rds CreateCloudMigrationTask --region cn-hangzhou --SourceAccount migratetest --SourcePort 5432 --SourcePassword 123456 --SourceCategory aliyunRDS --DBInstanceName 'pgm-bp102g323jd40000' --SourceIpAddress '172.16.XX.XX'
description_en: Creates a migration-to-cloud task for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 该接口用于创建RDS PostgreSQL迁移上云任务
kebab_example: aliyun rds create-cloud-migration-task --db-instance-name pgm-bp102g323jd40000 --source-ip-address 172.16.XX.XX --source-port 5432 --source-account migratetest --source-password 123456 --source-category aliyunRDS --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCloudMigrationTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target instance. You can invoke the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances接口查询
parameters.name: db_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The internal or public IP address of the self-managed PostgreSQL database.

To migrate a self-managed PostgreSQL database on an ECS instance to the cloud, set this parameter to the private IP address of the ECS instance. For more information about how to obtain the IP address, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98677.html.
To migrate a self-managed PostgreSQL database in an Internet Data Center (IDC) to the cloud, set this parameter to the internal IP address of the IDC
parameters.help_zh:
自建PostgreSQL数据库的内网IP或公网IP。

ECS自建PostgreSQL数据库一键上云场景，配置ECS实例的私网IP。获取方法请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98677.html。
IDC自建PostgreSQL数据库一键上云场景，配置为IDC的内网IP
parameters.name: source_ip_address

parameters.help_en: The port of the self-managed PostgreSQL database. You can run the `netstat -a | grep PGSQL` command to view the port
parameters.help_zh: 自建PostgreSQL数据库的端口。可通过`netstat -a | grep PGSQL`命令查看
parameters.name: source_port

parameters.help_en: The username. The database account created in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/369500.html step
parameters.help_zh: 用户名。https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/369500.html步骤创建的数据库账号
parameters.name: source_account

parameters.help_en: The password. The password of the database account created in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/369500.html step
parameters.help_zh: 密码。https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/369500.html步骤创建的数据库账号的密码
parameters.name: source_password

parameters.help_en: The task name. You can specify a custom name. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically generates a name
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称。自定义，未设置时系统自动生成
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en:
The category of the source instance.

aliyunRDS: ApsaraDB RDS instance.
other: other
parameters.help_zh:
源实例类别。

aliyunRDS：阿里云RDS实例。
other：其他
parameters.name: source_category

DBInstanceName.description_en: The name of the target instance
